next.reason: 1985: "Once the execution of a SEND statement has released a portion of a message to the MCS, only subsequent execution of SEND statements"; 2023: "GR-14.9.38.4-4: "A message is sent to the run unit identified by..." Each SEND sends one whole message; partial messages are gone.". 2023 drops the 1985 communication module's partial message release. Its SEND sends a complete message to a message server run unit, so no rule governs releasing the rest of a message.
